# dgVoodoo2

The Chapter Two launcher can bundle the unmodified x86 `MS/x86/D3D8.dll` from dgVoodoo2 2.87.6 to render the original game through Direct3D 11.

- [Original release](https://github.com/dege-diosg/dgVoodoo2/releases/tag/2.87.6)
- [Distribution terms and configuration documentation](https://www.dege.x3.hu/dgVoodoo2/ReadmeGeneral/)

SHA-256 of the original `MS/x86/D3D8.dll` is `25a0ceeb85fcc4675c6f964442eecc14fedd504effd39c931a627249ad4685e2`.
